newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of the Currie Cup rugby union matches played over the weekend:
In Potchefstroom: Free State beat North West (formerly Western Transvaal) 38-24 (halftime 18-17)
Scorers:
North West - Tries: AC Prinsloo, Charl Bensch, Lukas Swart. Conversions: Bertus Kruger (3). Dropped goal: Prinsloo.
Free State - Tries: Chris Badenhorst, Stephen Brink, Kat Myburgh, Jaco Coetzee, WJ Visagie. Conversions: Franco Smith, Visagie. Penalties: Smith, Visagie, Christo Potgieter.
In Durban: Natal beat Gauteng Falcons (formerly Eastern Transvaal) 56-10 (halftime (22-3)
Scorers:
Natal - Tries: Andre Joubert (2), Shaun Payne (2), Joos Joubert, Pieter Muller, Ollie le Roux, Wayne Fyvie. Conversions: Joubert (4), Knox. Penalties: Knox, Joubert.
Gauteng Falcons - Try: Piet Matthys. Conversion: Gert Peens. Penalty: Peens.
In Pietersburg: Northern Free State beat Northern Transvaal 36-34 (halftime 23-13)
Scorers:
Northern Free State - Tries: Stephen Nieuwenhuyzen (2), Willie Nagel. Conversions: Eric Herbert (3). Penalties: Herbert (3). Drop goals: Herbert (2).
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Brent Moyle, Conrad Breytenbach, Jannie Claasens, Adriaan Richter. Conversion: Casper Steyn. Penalies: Steyn (3), Johan Grobbelaar.
In Kimberley: Griqualand West drew with Boland 28-28 (halftime 28-6).
Scorers:
Griqualand West - Tries: Basil de Coning, Luther Bakkes, Albert van der Bergh, Andre Vermeulen. Conversions: Franco Smith (4).
Boland - Tries: McNeil Hendricks, Stefan Terblanche, Elmo Wolfaardt. Conversions: Pieter O'Neill (2). Penalties: O'Neill (3).
In Port Elizabeth: Gauteng Lions (formerly Transvaal) beat Eastern Province 46-13 (halftime 27-3).
Scorers:
Eastern Province - Tries: Deon Kayser, Henry Pedro. Penalty: Clive Terreblanche.
Gauteng Lions - Tries: Johan Roux (2), Theunis Delport, Chris Rossouw, Andre Vos, Louis van Rensburg. Conversions: Roux (5). Penalties: Roux (2).
In Cape Town: Western Province beat Border 56-15 (halftime 29-15).
Scorers:
Western Province - Tries: Andy Marinos (2), Toks van der Linde (2), Justin Swart (2), Peet Arnold, Michael Kirsten, Louis Blom. Conversions: Louis Koen (4). Penalty: Koen.
Border - Tries: Richard Bennett, Nico Venter. Conversion: Greg Miller. Penalty: Miller.
